@osqd/ui 0.4.0

Documentation

A utilitarian UI kit: plain CSS classes that work in any page, React components that render the same classes, and custom elements for pages without React. 140 components and 13 custom elements, each page generated from the source.

Inputs

21 components · gallery

Controls people type into, click and pick with.

ButtonThe main action control: four variants (solid, outline, soft, ghost), seven intents, three sizes and a loading state. ButtonGroupJoins buttons into one segmented control with shared borders. CalendarA month grid with the WAI-ARIA date-grid keyboard: arrows, PageUp/PageDown (+Shift for years), Home/End, Enter. CheckboxA checkbox with its label, including the indeterminate state. ComboboxA text box that filters a listbox: ↑↓ move, Enter picks, Escape closes (WAI-ARIA combobox, list autocomplete). ConfirmButtonA destructive action that asks for a second click instead of opening a dialog. DatePickerA date field that opens a calendar popover, with min/max, disabled days, optional time and Today/Clear. DateRangePickerPicks a start and end date on a two-month calendar, with quick ranges (last 24 hours, 7 days …) and optional times. DropZoneA dashed drop area that is also a file picker (click, Enter or Space). FileItemOne file in a FileList: name, size, progress or error, and a remove button. FileListThe list of chosen files under a DropZone. IconButtonA square button holding only an icon; label is required and becomes its accessible name (and, optionally, a tooltip). NumberInputA spin button: − and + around a text box, arrow keys, clamped to min/max and rounded to the step. RadioA single radio button with its label; use inside a RadioGroup. RadioGroupGroups radios under one name and value, with a label and optional horizontal layout. SegmentedA compact single-choice switch of a few options, e.g. a time range. SelectA labelled native select taking options or option children, with a placeholder. SliderA range slider with label and the current value shown. SwitchAn on/off toggle with its label, for settings that apply immediately. TagInputTags as chips in an input-like box: Enter or comma adds, Backspace on an empty box removes the last. TextFieldA labelled text input with help text, error, required mark, prefix/suffix adornments and a multiline mode.

Forms

15 components · gallery

Validation, structured inputs and multi-step flows on top of the inputs.

CidrInputA CIDR block, with its range and size worked out underneath. ColorInputA colour field: swatch, hex text, the native picker and preset swatches taken from the current theme. ConfirmProviderHosts the confirmation dialog for its subtree; useConfirm() inside it returns await confirm({...}) → boolean. CronInputA cron schedule edited field by field, read back in plain words with the next few runs. ErrorSummaryLists every invalid field after a submit, each a link that focuses the field. FieldShellThe label, help and error frame shared by the form inputs; wrap a custom control in it to get the same layout. FormA <form> wired to useForm: browser validation off (the rules decide), submit runs form.submit. IpInputAn IP address with its version shown beside it; complains once the field is left. KeyValueEditorEdits a list of key–value pairs (headers, environment variables) with add, remove, reorder and duplicate-key warnings. MultiSelectMany-of-many choice: a closed box showing chips, opening a checkbox list with search and "Select all". OtpInputA row of single-character boxes for one-time codes; pasting fills every box and Backspace moves back. PasswordInputA password field with show/hide and an optional strength meter. QueryBuilderA search box that turns field:value into chips: autocomplete for field names and their values, an operator on each chip that cycles through the ones the field allows, free text for the rest. SaveBarThe "unsaved changes" bar: appears while there is something to save. WizardA multi-step form on top of Stepper: Back / Next / Finish, with each step checked before moving on.

Data display

25 components · gallery

Surfaces and small pieces that show information.

AccordionA stack of collapsible sections. AccordionItemOne collapsible section of an Accordion: a summary line and its content. AvatarA person or service shown as a picture or as initials taken from name. AvatarGroupOverlapping avatars with a "+n" avatar for the ones over max. BadgeA small count bubble, on its own or anchored to the corner of its children. CardA bordered surface that groups related content, with optional header, body and footer. CardBodyThe padded content area of a Card; flush removes the padding for tables and lists. CardFooterThe bottom row of a Card, usually holding its buttons. CardHeaderThe top row of a Card: title, subtitle and actions. CardToolA plain toggle button styled as a card tool, for anything else that belongs in the header. CardToolsFold and pin buttons for a card header. ChipA compact label for a status, tag or filter; can be removable (onDelete) or toggleable (selected). CodeBlockPreformatted code with a header (language, filename), a copy button, optional line numbers and highlighted lines. DescriptionListKey–value pairs in two aligned columns, for detail panes and settings readouts. DotA small coloured circle for status, optionally pulsing. EmptyStateThe message shown where content would be but there is none yet, with an optional action. ListA vertical list of rows, optionally hoverable. ListItemOne row of a List: leading element, primary and secondary text, and meta on the right. PaperA plain surface with a hairline border, optionally raised with a shadow. PreviewFrameAn iframe preview of a page at phone, tablet or desktop width: a challenge page, an email. SortableListA list the user can reorder: drag the handle (mouse, pen or touch), press ↑ / ↓ on the focused handle, or use the move buttons. StatA KPI tile: label, large value with unit, and a change shown as up or down. StatusDotA dot followed by its label — "Healthy", "Degraded". TimelineA vertical log of events, each with a coloured dot, time, title and body. TreeViewA WAI-ARIA tree: ↑↓ move, → opens or enters, ← closes or goes to the parent, Enter/Space select, Home/End jump.

Data

8 components · gallery

Tables, logs, JSON and diffs, built to stay fast on large data.

ChipGridA long list of values (CIDR ranges, ASNs) as a filterable grid of fixed-height chips. DataTableColumns + rows in, a sortable, selectable table out. DiffViewTwo texts compared line by line (Myers' shortest edit script), unified or side by side, with line numbers, folded context and the changed words marked inside each changed line. JsonInspectorA JSON value as a collapsible tree: type-coloured values, sizes on arrays and objects, search that keeps the matching branches open, and copy buttons for the value and its path ($.request.headers["user-agent"]). LogViewerA log stream: virtualised so a long tail stays fast, follows new lines unless you scroll up (then a pill counts what arrived), and searches with next/previous over every match. TableA styled HTML table with dense, striped, hover and bordered options and a sticky header. TablePaginationThe footer under a paged table: rows per page, "21–40 of 312", previous and next. VirtualTableA data grid for very long lists: only the rows in view (plus overscan) are in the DOM, so 100 000 rows scroll as smoothly as 100.

Charts

13 components · gallery

Plain-SVG charts coloured by the theme, with tooltips and accessible tables.

AreaChartA line chart with the area under each line filled; stacked sums the series. BarChartBar chart in plain SVG: vertical or horizontal, grouped or stacked, with axes, legend, tooltips and an accessible data table. DonutChartPart-to-whole for a handful of categories (five or fewer reads best); fold the rest into "Other". FunnelStages that narrow: probed → engaged → trapped → blocked. GaugeA semicircle meter: the same scale and colouring as Meter, for a single headline number. HeatmapA grid of cells shaded on one sequential scale, e.g. requests per hour and weekday, with a scale strip and tooltips. HistogramCounts per bucket as vertical bars, with an optional threshold line: a score distribution. LineChartChange over time: one 2px line per series, crosshair and tooltip on hover, arrow keys when focused. MeterA labelled horizontal bar for a value in a known range, coloured by low/high/optimum thresholds like the native meter element. PercentileStripWhere the percentiles of a distribution fall on one track: latency p50 / p95 / p99. RankedBarsA labelled horizontal bar per item, longest first: top IPs, paths, countries. SparklineA tiny line or area chart for a trend inside a stat tile, table cell or list row. StackBarOne bar split into shares of 100%, with a legend: a response mix, a status split.

Navigation

12 components · gallery

Moving between pages, sections and steps.

AppBarThe top bar of an application: brand, navigation and actions. BreadcrumbsThe path to the current page as links, the last item marked current. NavA vertical list of navigation items. NavItemA link when href is set, otherwise a button. NavSectionA small uppercase heading that groups items in a Nav. PaginationPage buttons with previous/next and a window of pages around the current one. SkipLink"Skip to content": hidden until focused, the first thing a keyboard user reaches. StepperShows progress through ordered steps, horizontal or vertical, each done, current, upcoming or in error. TabsWAI-ARIA tabs: arrows move between tabs, Home/End jump, focus follows selection. ToolbarA row of controls with one tab stop (WAI-ARIA toolbar): ←→ move between buttons, Home/End jump. ToolbarLabelA short text label inside a Toolbar. ToolbarSeparatorA vertical line between groups of toolbar controls.

Overlays

10 components · gallery

Content that floats above the page.

CommandPaletteA search box over commands in a modal: ↑↓ move, Enter runs, Escape closes. ContextMenuA right-click menu over its children; also opens from the keyboard (Shift+F10 or the Menu key) and with a long press on touch screens. DialogA modal dialog on the native dialog element, or a drawer sliding in from the right; Escape and a backdrop click call onClose. DropdownA trigger and a menu that closes on outside click, Escape, or choosing an item. MenuA floating list of actions, usually inside a Dropdown. MenuItemOne action in a Menu, with an optional icon and shortcut hint. MenuLabelA small heading over a group of menu items. MenuSeparatorA thin line between groups of menu items. PopoverA panel anchored to its trigger with an arrow; closes on outside click and Escape. TooltipWraps one element and shows a short text label on hover and keyboard focus.

Feedback

14 components · gallery

Status, progress, loading and error states.

AlertAn inline message with an intent colour, default icon, optional title, actions and close button. BannerA full-width strip at the top of a page or panel: maintenance, trial, read-only mode. CalloutAn inline aside inside text: a note, a tip, something important, a caution. ErrorPageA full-page error or status screen: 404, 500, offline, no access. NotificationCenterA bell with an unread count that opens the notification panel. NotificationPanelThe list of notifications, grouped by day. ProgressA horizontal progress bar for a known value, or indeterminate while the amount is unknown. SkeletonA shimmering placeholder block shown while content loads. SkeletonCardA placeholder <Card>: optional media, a title, text and actions. SkeletonListPlaceholder rows for a <List>. SkeletonTableA placeholder table with a header row; numeric-looking last column right-aligned. SkeletonTextLines of placeholder text; the last one is shorter. SpinnerA small rotating indicator for work in progress. ToastProviderHosts toast notifications for its subtree; useToast() inside it shows and dismisses them.

Layout

13 components · gallery

Page structure, spacing and app shells.

CollapsibleShellThe app shell with a sidebar that collapses to an icon rail on wide screens and becomes a slide-in drawer (with a backdrop) on narrow ones. DetailLayoutA detail page: header across the top, the main content, and a column of properties beside it. DetailSectionA titled block in a DetailLayout's main column. DividerA horizontal or vertical rule, optionally with a label in the middle. GridA responsive grid that fits as many columns of at least min width as the space allows. PageHeaderThe top of a page: where you are, what this is, and what you can do with it. RowA horizontal flex row, vertically centred by default. ShellApp bar across the top, sidebar on the left, main content scrolling beside it. ShellNavItemA nav item that keeps its name in the rail (as a tooltip and as the accessible name). ShellToggleThe sidebar button for the app bar: collapses/expands the rail on wide screens and opens the drawer on narrow ones (two buttons, one shown per breakpoint, so each has an honest label). SidebarThe side panel of a Shell that holds the navigation. SplitPaneTwo panes with a draggable, keyboard-resizable separator between them. StackA vertical flex column.

Typography

3 components · gallery

Text styles.

CodeInline code inside running text. KbdA keyboard key, for shortcuts in text and menus. TypographyText in one of the kit's styles: headings h1–h5, body, small, tiny, overline, with muted/faint/mono options.

Theme

4 components · gallery

Themes, density and app-wide providers.

DensityProviderSets data-density for everything inside: compact and comfortable rescale the spacing unit, control heights and text steps; "default" leaves the theme's own sizes. ShortcutsOverlayA dialog listing shortcuts by group. ShortcutsProviderHolds the page's shortcuts, fires them from one keydown listener, and (by default) shows the list in an overlay on "?". ThemeProviderApplies a theme (a built-in name, "auto" or a createTheme object) to its subtree or, with fullPage, to the whole page.

Icons

2 components · gallery

The icon set and the empty-state illustrations.

IconOne icon from the set, inline. IllustrationA spot illustration for empty and error states; it recolours with the theme.

Getting started

Install

sh 
npm install @osqd/ui

Plain CSS

html 
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/@osqd/ui/dist/osqd-ui.css"> <body class="oq" data-theme="dark">  <button class="oq-btn">Save</button>  <button class="oq-btn oq-btn--outline oq-neutral">Cancel</button></body>

React

tsx 
import "@osqd/ui/css";import { ThemeProvider, Button } from "@osqd/ui"; export function App() {  return (    <ThemeProvider theme="dark" fullPage>      <Button color="primary">Deploy</Button>    </ThemeProvider>  );}

Web Components (no React, no build)

html 
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/@osqd/ui/dist/osqd-ui.css"><script src="node_modules/@osqd/ui/assets/osqd-ui-elements.js" defer></script> <oq-tabs>…markup that already uses the kit's classes…</oq-tabs>

Themes

html 
<!-- dark · light · graphite · midnight · contrast · paper · slate · auto --><html class="oq" data-theme="midnight"> <!-- any subtree can carry its own theme --><section data-theme="paper">…</section>

Density

html 
<div data-density="compact">…</div>   <!-- compact · comfortable -->

Icons

html 
<svg class="oq-icon"><use href="node_modules/@osqd/ui/assets/icons.svg#oq-i-search"/></svg> // React<Icon name="search" />
